program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (at g 2 1)))
             (list (map (lambda (c) (at g 0 c)) (range 0 w))
                   (map (lambda (c) (at g 1 c)) (range 0 w))
                   (map (lambda (c) (if (= (at g 0 c) bg) bg 6)) (range 0 w)))))))
